title: String to Integer (atoi)
description: Implement the `myAtoi(string s)` function, which converts a string to a 32-bit signed integer. Whitespace is ignored, optional sign is parsed, digits are converted, and result is clamped to [-2^31, 2^31 - 1].

hints.content: Check for "+" or "-" to determine sign.
Accumulate numeric digits until non-digit is hit, then clamp to 32-bit integer limits.

solution.explanation:
Sequential parsing: trim whitespace, read optional sign, consume digits, and clamp to 32-bit bounds.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(1)
